name: rare-window-minor

finding.title: `Submit` can miss the wake-up and leave a queued job waiting one poll interval
finding.description: When `Submit` runs after the worker's empty `Pop` at line 24 and before `w.waiting.Store(true)` at line 28, it reads `waiting` as false and sends no wake-up. The worker then sleeps the whole `w.interval`, one second by default, while a job sits in the queue. The job still runs, up to a second late.
finding.suggestedFix: Set `waiting` before the last `Pop`, or have `Submit` always try a non-blocking send on `w.wake`.
